response.rationale: Six of seven cited items (including a T1 meta-analysis and several T3 studies) show that prior language knowledge improves comprehension-related outcomes such as cognate recognition, guessing and translation of unknown related languages, though the T1 meta-analysis finds only weak transfer for oral language, van Hell 2002 finds L3 effects only at high proficiency, and the single negative T6 item (Best 2007) shows that transfer depends on how L2 contrasts map onto L1 categories, so support is real but conditional.
